  "goal": "Margin V2 R1 — Floating Window Host Architecture. A research/decision-only task (stated: 只调研，不修改代码) to select the simplest reliable desktop floating-window host for Margin V2. Scope: compare Electron, Tauri, and other mature lightweight desktop/WebView options on reuse of the existing React/Web UI, ability to call the local Node/Core backend, Windows support, installer size, memory, tray/always-on-top/hide-show, development and packaging/signing complexity, community maturity, and cross-platform cost; choose how the GUI binds to Core (direct Core call vs local backend vs reusing the existing HTTP Surface); keep the V2 minimum product limited to Workspace Overview, Recent Sessions, Resume Summary, Generate/Save HANDOFF, and Copy checkpoint (explicitly exclude live agent monitoring, usage, launcher, checkpoint lifecycle, search/archive/delete, complex settings); and deliver outputs 1-11 (host comparison, recommended host, Core<->GUI architecture, existing Browser-code reuse, packaging approach, V2 minimum window behavior, biggest risks, first implementation slice, acceptance criteria, model ROI, and a 'STOP - enough evidence' marker).",
  "progress": "Historical (HANDOFF.md, 2026-09-07T09:27Z, session 01a0755d): the assistant reported the research essentially concluded, recommending Electron + the existing local HTTP Surface (not Tauri; Tauri's size win is offset by keeping the Node Core running plus Rust/sidecar/native-dependency costs), with Electron Forge for packaging, vite build -> Forge package/make, a single-instance lock, a small always-hideable frameless floating BrowserWindow (~460x680 expanded per report text; the report also mentions collapsed-tray behavior), tray show/hide, Close->hide, Quit cleans up the loopback server, and near-zero UI business-code change for the first slice. It claimed it modified no code or workspace files. No case-03 plan/spec/ADR/decision document exists anywhere in the repo, and README.md (header still 'Phase 2B Web Workbench') and CHANGELOG.md (top still Phase 2A/2B-era) do not yet document the V2 Electron/CLI handoff state.",

(4) README/CHANGELOG not yet updated for the V2/Electron/CLI state is an observed documentation gap, but the historical task was research-only and forbade file modification, so acting on it requires explicit instruction.",

None of these were rerun here and none can be rerun in this environment: workspace has no node_modules, no web/dist, no pinned .runtime node, no git binary, node is not runnable, the sandbox is inspect-only, and data/ is empty except .gitkeep.",

Flag the README/CHANGELOG drift as a documentation follow-up only if instructed.",
